title: Nameless One
html_source:
This reference to the poem by that title by James Clarence Mangan, which, if the reader will study it, will reveal much of what haunted Joyce about his own life. There are so many parallels between this poem written long before Joyce’s birth and Joyce’s life as well as with much of the imagery in Ulysses, it is difficult to believe it was not studied by Joyce. Not the least significant comparison is the fact that the “nameless one” in the poem was thirty-nine years old, Joyce’s precise age the year Ulysses was completed.
